title: QuantAlgo
description: Manual system evaluation and automated trading bots

capabilities.name: get_trade_stats
capabilities.description: Aggregate trade statistics for the journal.

capabilities.name: run_backtest
capabilities.description: Backtest a strategy. Compute only - places no orders.

capabilities.name: list_bots
capabilities.description: Every trading bot with its status and live snapshot (equity, cash, open positions).

capabilities.name: start_bot
capabilities.description: Start a bot by id (see list_bots). PLACES REAL ORDERS when the bot is in live mode.

bot_id.description: The bot to start, from list_bots.

capabilities.name: stop_bot
capabilities.description: Stop a running bot by id; without an id every bot stops.

bot_id.description: The bot to stop; omit to stop all.

capabilities.name: research_run
capabilities.description: Start a QuantScript research draft as a forge job and return at once. Freezes the engine, the draft's library and the market data, then runs the full native Gauntlet with walk-forward optimization (kind gauntlet) or the native system backtests (kind profit). Poll quantsuite.script.research_read and forge_jobs. One forge job runs at a time. The answer, research_list and research_read carry report_html, the standalone HTML report's file; when the run is done (report_ready true), give the user that path. The report also opens in QuantScript → Forge → Research.

capabilities.name: research_gauntlet_overview
capabilities.description: Report tool 1/3: the Gauntlet report of the active library's existing native evidence, without re-testing. Per indicator: Standard and selected-per-track verdicts on 1h/4h/1d, worst-track overall score, p-values, five axes, walk-forward, parameters, CSV export. Creates a research run and starts it as a forge job; returns the run id at once. The answer, research_list and research_read carry report_html, the standalone HTML report's file; when the run is done (report_ready true), give the user that path. Poll quantsuite.script.research_read; the English report also opens in QuantScript → Forge → Research.

indicators.description: Base indicator keys to include; omit for the whole library.

capabilities.name: research_profit_overview
capabilities.description: Report tool 2/3: the most profitable single indicators and aggregates (2+ distinct base indicators) in a saved QuantSystems system, ranked by final capital against its current setup. Bulk evaluation identical to the native engine; every shown candidate is re-run natively. Report: rankings, capital curves, profit vs drawdown, annual returns, method. Creates a research run and starts it as a forge job; returns the run id at once. The answer, research_list and research_read carry report_html, the standalone HTML report's file; when the run is done (report_ready true), give the user that path. The report also opens in QuantScript → Forge → Research. Large libraries take a while (signals per indicator and pair); poll quantsuite.script.research_read and forge_jobs.

system.description: A saved system's name or id (QuantSystems).

config.description: An explicit system config instead of a saved system.

indicators.description: Candidate keys; omit for each base indicator's version for the system's track.

sizes.description: Aggregate sizes to test; omit for 2 up to all bases.

capabilities.name: research_aggregate_comparison
capabilities.description: Report tool 3/3: a variable-size aggregate search in a saved QuantSystems system against its current aggregate (or a given reference). Any size from two distinct base indicators; stages fixed before results (reference neighbours, two additions, pairs, balanced sizes, local search). Report: new leader vs current (capital and drawdown), top 10, best of each size, independent later starts, search coverage. Bulk evaluation identical to the native engine; the top 10 and the best small sizes are re-run natively. Creates a research run and starts it as a forge job; returns the run id at once. The answer, research_list and research_read carry report_html, the standalone HTML report's file; when the run is done (report_ready true), give the user that path. The report also opens in QuantScript → Forge → Research.

system.description: A saved system's name or id (QuantSystems).

config.description: An explicit system config instead of a saved system.

indicators.description: Candidate keys; omit for each base indicator's version for the system's track.

reference.description: The aggregate to beat; omit for the system's own.

sizes.description: Aggregate sizes to test; omit for 2 up to all bases.

restarts.description: Later start dates for independent runs (default 2023-01-01, 2025-01-01).

capabilities.name: forge_jobs
capabilities.description: Forge jobs with status, progress, errors and verdict summaries; detail = a job id returns that job's full event list.

detail.description: A job id from this list.

capabilities.name: forge_cancel
capabilities.description: Cancel the running forge job and its worker processes. A cancelled research run stays visible as interrupted with its partial evidence.

capabilities.name: forge_info
capabilities.description: The forge's market data shelf, its saved reports and the certification tracks.

refresh.description: Re-read the vault instead of the cached listing.

capabilities.name: forge_run
capabilities.description: Start a forge job on the active library: gauntlet, optimize, walkforward, compare or refresh (market data). For new indicators use quantsuite.script.research_create and research_run instead. Certification needs the full protocol; fast is a smoke test only.

resume.description: optimize only: skip indicators whose versions are current.

capabilities.name: list_indicators
capabilities.description: Every indicator version QuantAlgo can use, with its per-track and overall Gauntlet verdicts. Refresh after quantsuite.script.research_install.

refresh.description: Re-read the registry instead of the cache.

capabilities.name: create_strategy_from_indicator
capabilities.description: Create a QuantAlgo strategy from an installed indicator version with its tested parameters. Creates no bot and starts nothing.

params.description: Optional parameter overrides, checked against the indicator's schema.
